Bandpass.Description: Built-in amplifier band pass 0.15 to 200 Hz, 1-pole, so no sharp corner at 200 Hz; amplitude roll-off function in ns_1k_1_300_filt.mat (speech_lists README (SDR zk881ps0522)).

TaskDescription: Noun reading and verb generation for two lists of 40 nouns, each list presented 3 times for noun reading then 3 times for verb production (12 runs in the order nounsL1R1-R3, verbsL1R1-R3, nounsL2R1-R3, verbsL2R1-R3); written nouns about 1 m away, 1.6 s cues alternating with 1.6 s blank-screen intervals; meant to test working memory and cognitive load in the language system. Audio of patient speech is not included. (speech_lists README)
Instructions: Noun runs: read the noun. Verb runs: 'produce a verb that was connected to the noun (it could be something they might do to that noun, or that the object/animal might do itself)'; repeating or changing verbs across runs was left to the patient (speech_lists README).
